title: Next Greater Element I
description:
You are given two arrays:

nums2 → the main array
nums1 → a subset of nums2

For each element in nums1, find its next greater element in nums2.

What is “Next Greater Element”?

For a value x in nums2:

Look to the right of x
Find the first element greater than x
If none exists → answer is -1
Task

Return an array ans where:

ans[i] = next greater element of nums1[i] in nums2
Examples

Example 1

nums1 = [4,1,2]
nums2 = [1,3,4,2]
→ [-1,3,-1]

Example 2

nums1 = [2,4]
nums2 = [1,2,3,4]
→ [3,-1]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
The third line contains an integer m.
The fourth line contains m space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
constraints:
1 ≤ nums1.length ≤ nums2.length ≤ 1000
All elements are unique
nums1 is a subset of nums2
